'''Gorg dipping sauce''' was a dipping sauce created from the [[Gorg/Legends|Gorg]] and used by [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra]] in her shop in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
